summary: One answer schema for structured person requests: chosen answers with optional per-answer notes, and the person's words beside them. Approved as HIGH by the user: "Clean cut, I approve HIGH (Recommended)".

replay.detail: No replay. Stored answers are never rewritten: a one-function read-time reader (person_request::read_answer) presents legacy {id, label, text} answers as {choices, words}, with legacy text read as words.

schema.detail: No SQLite table or migration change. The local attention projection's fingerprint gains work-done-answer.v2.one-answer-schema, so open attention rows are rebuilt once with the new prefilled read answer. A new meta key answer_schema_switched records the fleet barrier below.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or retention change.

compatibility.detail: Breaking client contract (clean cut, HIGH, user-approved): work.done / PersonAnswerInput takes {choices: [{id, note?}], words?} and refuses the old {id, text} with validation-failed; the recorded PersonAnswer is {type, outcome, choices: [{id, label, note?}], words?}; the CLI replaces `work done --answer ID --text TEXT` with `--choice ID[=NOTE]` and `--words TEXT`. StructuredRequest gains optional `words: none|optional|required`. Mixed fleet (R49): the daemon advertises daemon.started feature person_answer_schema=1, and until every other member advertises it, a recorded answer also carries the legacy id, label and text fields, so agents on older members keep dispatching on id; older members read the summary line, which carries every note and word. Clients: after the daemon upgrade, older iOS builds, older TUIs and any client not built from this source cannot answer structured requests until updated; they receive a typed validation error, never a silent drop.

manual.detail: Update the iOS app and any scripts calling `fractal work done --answer/--text` to `--choice ID[=NOTE]` / `--words TEXT`. Agents reading person_answers should read choices[].id instead of id (fractal skill describes the schema).

recovery.detail: Swap-back to an older build reads new answers without id at the top level only where the barrier had switched; roll forward instead. No database recovery is needed.
